resources.string: Sends text and images you copy on this phone to your Mac automatically. Mac n Droid only reacts to Copy actions and notices which app is open. It can\'t tap or type on your screen, and it doesn\'t read or store what\'s on it.

Lets you use this phone from the Phone Screen window on your paired Mac: clicks become taps, and you can scroll, type and use Back, Home and Recents. It only acts on what you do in that window. It doesn\'t read or store what\'s on your screen. Some banking apps show a warning while this is on.
